rule_or_pattern: Drop lines flagged C:cpp_vs_book_out or C:len_vs_book_high, D:column_crossing_line/column_merge_line lines, and C:cph_out_of_range lines whose label is shorter than ~60% of the book's median characters for that crop width (a label covering only part of the crop); also crops taller than ~1.4x the page's median line height.
notes: This is a typewritten 1987 parliament record in the dev split. Most lines read correctly, including the running heads (24, 29-37). A subset has a label that covers only part of the crop or a different line. Line 3 ends at 'επεβλήθη' while the crop continues 'στο Ταμείο για αντι-', and 38 gives 'περίοδο είναι αυτονόητο' for a longer line. Lines 36 and 40 carry labels from other lines ('αποτελούν αντικίνητρο', 'απαραίτητη χρηματοδότη'), and 32 reads the line below a two-line crop. Line 21 merges two columns. Line 26 has the spurious 'μένεςι'.
